content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Settings Tab ## slug: events-admin-tab-settings ## seoTitle: Settings Tab ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End ![Events Admin Tab_Settings Tab](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Events%20Admin%20Tab_Settings%20Tab.png){height="" width=""} ## Vanity Domain {{snippet.URL_Limitation}} The {{variable.Field_Domain_VanityDomain}} field allows users to set a domain other than https://events.blackthorn.io for the remote site "Events_Domain." To confirm if the update is successful, check the following: * For the remote site "Events_Domain," go to Setup > Security > Remote Site Settings > Events_Domain. * For the Platform Domain field, go to Custom Settings > Blackthorn | Events Settings > Click "Manage" > Platform Domain. For more information about custom domains, go to [Customized Blackthorn Events Domain](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/custom-domains){target="_blank"}. ## Favicon URL Users with Event Admin permissions can add a favicon URL to the {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_FaviconUrl}} field. The added favicon URL is stored in the Event Settings. For more information, go to [Favicon URL](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/event-settings-1#favicon-url){target="_blank"}.
